name: drive-vetting-workbench
description: Local-first, evidence-backed Google Drive review and non-destructive change workbench.

scripts.test:reasoning: pnpm --filter @dvw/reasoning test && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/reasoning
scripts.test:decisions: pnpm --filter @dvw/decision-memory test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/decisions
scripts.test:planning: pnpm --filter @dvw/change-planner test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/planning
scripts.test:lab: pnpm --filter @dvw/drive-simulator test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/lab
scripts.test:feedback: pnpm --filter @dvw/feedback test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/feedback
scripts.test:preflight: pnpm --filter @dvw/execution test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/preflight
scripts.test:execution: pnpm --filter @dvw/execution test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/execution
scripts.test:resume: pnpm --filter @dvw/execution test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/resume
scripts.test:e2e: vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts && pnpm review:browser-check && pnpm test:feedback-browser
scripts.test:pilot-rehearsal: pnpm --filter @dvw/reporting test && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/pilot-rehearsal.test.ts
scripts.verify:no-real-data: pnpm scan:secrets && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/no-real-data.test.ts
scripts.verify:scaffold: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm smoke:sqlite && pnpm check:workspace-boundary
scripts.verify:package: pnpm build && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:source-artifacts && pnpm examples:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm licenses:check && pnpm verify:cleanroom-quickstart && pnpm package:manifest:check && npm pack --dry-run --json
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:scaffold && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:security && pnpm verify:package
